read.en: Alphabet fell 4.1% on Nov 16 to $283.72, trading $282.96–294.13. It is below the 5-day ($291.8), 10-day ($288.4), 30-day ($316.5), 100-day ($337.8) and 200-day ($338.2); all but the 5-day are falling. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram easing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($280.60), and RSI is 34.5.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月16日下跌 4.1%，收于 $283.72，盘中区间 $282.96–294.13。股价位于 5 日（$291.8）、10 日（$288.4）、30 日（$316.5）、100 日（$337.8）和 200 日均线（$338.2）下方；除 5 日均线外均在下行。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$280.60），RSI 为 34.5。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports ($285.7–296.5), now resistance; the close is 1.1% above the SAR. Resistance is $285.7–288.4, then $291.8–294.1 and $300–305. Support is $280.6–283 (SAR, Nov 5 close, Nov 16 low), then $276.9–277.1 (Oct 30 and Nov 5 lows) and $270.7 (52-week low). A close above $288.4 would target $292–294; below $280.6, the SAR would flip bearish.
